body: Commit 9da7bb9: founder reported live 'the boyds stuff makes the team do a weird cluster dance around the objective ... not sitting right on it' -> 'at least one of them should sit right on it and ignore the flock.' Root cause: flocking's separation force is strongest exactly when allies are close, unavoidably true once bots converge on a shared node, so nobody ever settled long enough to make real capture progress. Fixed with a stateless anchor rule (owner index mod node count) -- one bot per node ignores the flock and sits exactly on it, everyone else still flocks as escort. Live-verified via isolated 20-bot match.
title: S170-168: boids anchor fix -- stops the 'cluster dance' around node objectives
